data.title: 胡桃 · 蝶引来生烈焰长枪
data.description: 【胡桃 · 蝶引来生烈焰长枪】炽热火光与阴阳符文交织的古战场上，护摩之杖通体迸发出灼热的赤红烈焰。胡桃压低重心单膝微蹲，双手紧握长枪破空挥斩，无数由纯净火元素凝结而成的火蝶在周身盘旋翻飞——「受命于天，既寿永昌！蝶引来生，火化九幽！」
data.action: 侧身压低重心单膝微蹲，双手紧握护摩之杖，周身火蝶飞舞烈焰升腾
data.lighting: 护摩之杖炽烈赤红火光与周身火蝶辉光
data.camera: full-body shot, dynamic low angle, both hands and full polearm visible
data.promptProse: Both hands firmly spaced on the Staff of Homa, Hu Tao crouches low over cracked altar stones and sweeps the complete polearm diagonally through the low full-body frame. Her coat tails and red-tipped twintails follow the strike. Flame butterflies circle the shaft against the dim battlefield. The staff's red glow illuminates her focused face and gripping hands, throwing angular stone shadows behind her grounded feet.
